services.name: Weekly Lawn Care
services.description: Regular scheduled service keeping your yard clean, trimmed, and healthy throughout the season.
typicalItems: Mowing to correct height for grass type
Edging along beds, walkways, and driveways
Blowing off hard surfaces after each visit
Visual health check at every visit
services.priceRange: Starting at $45/visit depending on yard size

services.name: Fertilization and Weed Control
services.description: Seasonal lawn treatment programs that build soil health and keep weeds from taking over.
typicalItems: Grub and insect prevention where needed
services.priceRange: $150-$600/season depending on yard size and program

services.name: Spring and Fall Cleanup
services.description: One-time visits to prepare the yard for the season ahead or close it down properly for winter.
typicalItems: Pruning dead growth from beds and shrubs
Final mow and trim before season end

services.name: Patio Installation
services.description: Natural stone, brick, or concrete paver patio installation built on a properly prepared base.

services.name: Landscape Design and Installation
services.description: Full design and installation of planting beds, trees, shrubs, and ground cover tailored to your property.
typicalItems: Plant installation with spacing and care plan

services.name: Retaining Walls
services.description: Block, stone, or timber retaining wall construction to manage grades, erosion, and usable yard space.
typicalItems: Wall construction with proper drainage backfill

services.name: Outdoor Lighting
services.description: Low-voltage landscape lighting for paths, trees, patios, and architectural features.
typicalItems: Path, uplighting, and accent fixture installation

services.name: Drainage Solutions
services.description: French drains, dry creek beds, and grading corrections to move water away from the house and keep the yard usable.
typicalItems: Site assessment and water flow mapping
French drain or channel drain installation
